trigger: pilot-01+1 lost r2-r4 to die-five calibration (r2/r3 end, r4 middle); losses reached 40 and the 30-candidate cap stopped capture. Resets had drifted from the street waypoint used throughout pilot-00 and pilot-01-r0 to a MACBA-wall waypoint, where the game turns the board and camera ~180 degrees about 2.3 s after each reset, settling about 1 s later. That motion falls inside the middle (reset+3.0 s) and end (reset+3.5 s) marker reference windows.

evidence.post_reset_motion_mean_abs_diff_0.5s: still views <= 3.4 (pilot-00 r0-r4, pilot-01-r0 and unaffected windows); turnaround windows 17.0-26.3 (pilot-01-r1 26 s; r2/r3 53.5 s; r4 26 s and 53.5 s)
evidence.detections: failing markers had 2-3 of 5 points fire early (frames 1-34); passing markers fired together

rule: The operator returns XR1 to the street waypoint. After every pre-roll reset, screenshots across 1.0-4.5 s must change by at most 10 (mean absolute grey difference, 64x144, rows 24-120); otherwise the pilot stops before any scientific touch (Gate 2). The 30-candidate cap counts only losses after the re-anchor; pilot-01+1's cap stop is reviewed and closed. pilot-01 remains 10/50; validation is at most 60.
limitations: The guard checks only the pre-roll reset. A drift during a recording still costs that recording's candidates and counts toward the cap.
